summary: Preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727KB sibling bundle
details: The package's declared purpose is a trivial test module whose main entry is a 6-line file exporting the string 'John'. Its `preinstall` script runs `setup.mjs`, which downloads a Bun runtime archive from GitHub releases (oven-sh/bun), extracts and chmods it, then invokes it via `execFileSync` against a bundled sibling file `math_init.js`. That sibling is a ~727KB heavily obfuscated Bun-bundled script (string-array/rotation obfuscation with a `WV8StW` shift routine over a giant `n7gIxM` literal array, hex-named identifiers, `// @bun @bun-cjs` header) that is not referenced by `lib/index.js` and has no relation to the advertised functionality. `setup.mjs` itself is obfuscator.io-style transformed (hex-prefixed imports like `_0x488df8`, property-table dispatchers such as `_0x19328d.YCZJE(execFileSync, 'ldd', [...])`) around the fetch-and-execute chain. The alternate-runtime execution path causes the obfuscated payload to run outside Node at install time, bypassing Node-based tooling that would otherwise observe the loaded code.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
